overall_reason: The palette is Tailwind's defaults used as the system: blue-600 #2563eb as the only accent, slate-50 #f8fafc paper, slate-900 #0f172a ink and five slate text greys, with no brand mark or imagery that chose them, and the accent also sets half the hero headline and every goal-tile icon.

score.reason: T-COLOUR-SOURCE finds only framework swatches, T-ACCENT-DOSAGE finds display type and decorative icons in the accent, and T-PALETTE-ROLES finds five text greys; the grounds and the grayscale fold hold up.

findings.title: Colour has a source
findings.where: whole page, :root and Tailwind utilities, 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: The palette table at 1440 lists the page ground #f8fafc, the ink #0f172a, the greys #334155, #475569, #64748b, #94a3b8 and #cbd5e1, and the accent #2563eb with hover #1d4ed8: these are Tailwind slate-50/300/400/500/600/700/900 and blue-600/700 exactly. The only colour tokens on :root are --tw-ring-color and --tw-ring-offset-color (stock_swatches flags --tw-ring-color #3b82f6). The logo is a slate-900 square with a white stack glyph, so nothing on the page supplies the blue.
findings.before: Framework slate greys and blue-600 as the whole colour system
findings.after: An accent and neutral set sampled from the product's own mark or content (Sample, Converge, Justify), written as named tokens rather than utility defaults
findings.why: A visitor cannot tell this page from any other Tailwind starter, because every colour on it is the framework's default.

findings.title: Display type is set in ink
findings.where: hero h1 second line, 1440 and 375, tiles/1440-00.png and tiles/375-00.png
findings.evidence: The palette table records one display-text use of the accent at 1440: "We'll build the stack." at 60px in #2563eb, directly under "Tell us the goal." in #0f172a.
findings.before: The second line of the h1 is set in the accent blue #2563eb
findings.after: The whole h1 in the ink #0f172a; the accent kept for the "Find my stack" action
findings.why: The 60px blue line competes with the blue "Find my stack" button 170px below, so the accent no longer points only at the action.

findings.title: The accent marks action and state
findings.where: goal tiles and How it works cards, 1440, tiles/1440-00.png bottom and tiles/1440-01.png
findings.evidence: All 10 goal tiles carry the same blue target icon on a pale blue tile, and the three How it works cards add blue target, wallet and code icons beside the numbered badges. None of these icons is an action or a state; the same blue fills the "Find my stack" and "Get started" buttons and the active "Home" nav item.
findings.before: Accent blue on 13 decorative icons and their tinted tiles
findings.after: Icons in the text grey; the accent held for the two primary buttons and the current nav item
findings.why: Repeating the action colour on 13 non-clickable icons dilutes the signal that blue means "press this".

findings.title: Text greys are a fixed set
findings.where: body, small and link text on the #f8fafc ground, 1440
findings.evidence: The text roles at 1440 use five greys on the light ground: #0f172a (23 headings), #334155 (7 links), #475569 (20 small, 5 body, 6 links), #64748b (23 small, 7 body) and #94a3b8 (3 small, 2 body). Body copy alone appears in three of them.
findings.before: Five slate text greys, with body text in #475569, #64748b and #94a3b8
findings.after: Three text levels on one ground: ink, secondary, and muted, each with one job
findings.why: Three body greys within a few screens make the reader guess which text is secondary; the lightest, #94a3b8, also fails contrast (the sweep's A11-001 hit on "20+ curated tools").

findings.title: A card has a border or a shadow
findings.where: goal tiles, How it works cards and tool cards, 1440, tiles/1440-01.png and tiles/1440-02.png
findings.evidence: The palette table counts 19 elements with both a border and the shadow rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04) 0 1px 2px; the tiles show a #e2e8f0 hairline plus a soft shadow on each card.
findings.before: Hairline border plus a 1px shadow on every card
findings.after: One edge per card: the hairline on the #f8fafc wells, with the shadow removed
findings.why: The second edge adds noise to 19 cards without separating anything the border does not already separate.

strengths: The tool avatars (ChatGPT green #10a37f, Claude #d97757, Gemini #4285f4, Perplexity #20b8cd, ElevenLabs #7c3aed) take each product's own brand colour, so the extra hues are content, not decoration.
Only two grounds (#f8fafc and #0f172a for the CTA panel and footer), and the primary button stays distinct in the grayscale fold (03-lenses/color/gray-fold-1440.png).
not_investigated: T-DARK-MODE: the page is light and the stylesheet ships no dark theme (no prefers-color-scheme, no color-scheme, no dark class).
The radial blue glows in the hero and CTA panel are the sweep's SLP-008 hit and are not repeated here; the Tailwind ring token is the sweep's CLR-002 hit.
The palette table reports 0 neutral text levels because slate greys have chroma about 0.04; the levels above were read from the text roles instead.
